scope: we conducted an unbiased proteomic analysis of the TRAIL-induced cancer secretome by mass spectrometry
To comprehensively determine which factors are secreted by cancer cells upon TRAIL stimulation, we conducted an unbiased mass spectrometric analysis of TRAIL’s secretome in resistant A549 cells.
The total protein content of the concentrated secretome was determined with the Bicinchoninic acid (BCA) assay.
